service.name: web-search
service.description: Federated web search provider with live results and a self-curating, citation-backed research knowledge store

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o web-search-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

searxng.description: Privacy-respecting metasearch aggregator (Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo/Startpage) backing the live-web path (L0/L1/L2). web-search calls its JSON API and normalizes results into the search-hub SearchHit shape; nothing external is stored except via the TTL cache and distilled findings.
searxng.degraded_behavior: If SearXNG is down, the web-search.live provider degrades to unavailable (surfaced warning + governor-style 'try later'); the web-search.learnings provider keeps serving internalized findings, so default federated queries are unaffected.

ollama.description: Local Ollama roles for the findings semantic index, L1 snippet synthesis, and L2/L3 finding distillation.
ollama.degraded_behavior: Embeddings unavailable -> findings search falls back to text matching and reindex is deferred; synthesis unavailable -> raw hits are still returned (synthesis is always additive/opt-in).

qdrant.description: Vector database for the semantic findings index (collection: web-search-findings) via the aisearch-go package, mirroring the cli-health adoption pattern.
qdrant.degraded_behavior: Semantic recall of findings falls back to BM25-style text matching; reindex is deferred.

reranker.description: Cross-encoder reranker (BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 via TEI) that reorders the findings shortlist for the strongest ordering.
reranker.degraded_behavior: Reranking falls back to raw dense (cosine) order; findings search still returns results, only the final ordering is less precise.

browser-automation-studio.description: Browser escalation leg of the L2 fetch stack (greenfield 2026-06, replacing the deleted browserless resource coupling). L2 fetches pages with plain HTTP first; when a page fails or extracts as a JS shell, web-search calls BAS CaptureService.Capture (Connect-RPC, inline_dom=true) for the rendered outerHTML. Disable the leg with WEB_SEARCH_BROWSER_ESCALATION=off.
browser-automation-studio.degraded_behavior: Without browser-automation-studio, L2 fetch is HTTP-only: server-rendered pages still synthesize normally; JS-shell pages contribute thin or no text, and L2 abstains only if every candidate page fails.

search-hub.description: Federated search router. web-search self-registers two providers from .vrooli/search.json at boot: web-search.live (SCOPE_EXTERNAL, rate-limited, reached only on explicit --type web/--all or fallback escalation) and web-search.learnings (SCOPE_PROJECT, local findings corpus, joins default routing). Registration is an idempotent upsert.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: If search-hub is down at boot, self-registration retries briefly then gives up; web-search serves its own search/research endpoints normally and re-registers on its next boot.

agent-manager.description: Agentic run lifecycle for L3 iterative research (OT-P1-002): web-search spawns an agent-manager run that uses L2 endpoints and web-search CLI commands as tools to plan, loop, verify, and emit a cited brief. The L3 RPC starts the run and returns a handle the caller polls via GetResearchStatus.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Without agent-manager, only L0/L1/L2 (single-pass) research is available; L3 iterative research-and-reconcile is unavailable.
